book: Goldast's 1606 Frankfurt edition of Alamannic historical writers in two tomes: Tomus I (Historiarum Alamannicarum partes I-II, with chronicles, monastic histories and saints' lives of St Gall, Reichenau and related houses, plus dedications, syllabus and Tibianus' panegyric) and Tomus II (Antiquitatum Alamannicarum, with the Alamannic law, charters, glossaries and indices).
